After doing n handstands, the gymnasts will end up in the same position as they started. The gymnasts will do handstands from top to bottom, one column at a time. This means that they will start from the top row and do handstands until the bottom row, shifting one column to the right each time.

If the grid is :
```
......
...Y..
...Y..
RRYRYY
```

```
..YY...
..YYYR.
..YYYR.
..RRYR.
```
After 2 handstands, the grid will be:
```
....YYY
....YYY
....RRY
....RRY

```

Then, we count the number of times the cell with the letter 'R' is flipped. This is the output of the function.
In the example above, the output is 2.
